test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 2nd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

H _ S _ _ P S _ _ P _ C
solution:
Given : H _ S _ _ P S _ _ P _ C

By checking options:

1) SCHCHS ⇒ H __**S**__ S __**C**__ __**H**__ P S __**C**__ __**H**__ P __**S**__ C → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

2) PCHHCS ⇒ H **__P__** S __C__ __H__ P S **__H__** **__C__** P __S__ C → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

3) PHCCHS ⇒ H **__P__** S **__H__** **__C__** P S __C__ __H__ P __S__ C → (It doesn't Follows the pattern) 

4) PCHCHS ⇒ H **__P__** S __C__ / __H__ P S __C__ / __H__ P __S__ C → **(It does Follows the pattern of H P S C - H P S C - H P S C)**

Option (4) Give a pattern of H __P__ S __C__ - __H__ P S __C__ - __H__ P __S__ C

Hence, the correct answer is **"PCHCHS****"**.
